text: Marrowgate Water Board chair Henrik Dalloway presided over a brief meeting Tuesday evening at the Riverton Civic Annex, where directors approved a $2.8 million pipeline renewal contract and set a public hearing for May 14. Dalloway said the board will begin work next month on the South Quay filtration upgrade, a project expected to reduce service interruptions for about 4,600 customers. The board also authorized emergency repairs to a cracked main on Larch Street after crews logged three breaks in nine days. “Our priority is reliable water service and clear communication with residents,” Dalloway said. The board said construction notices will be mailed to affected neighborhoods by Friday, and the hearing will be open to all Marrowgate ratepayers.
